# Nullbox

> Nullbox is a small, silly support ticketing system. Customers report problems, workers answer them, and everyone works toward Inbox Zero.

## Pages

- [Report a problem](https://team-08.fasthacks.cloud/): file a support ticket, with or without a name

## For agents

- [API description (OpenAPI)](https://team-08.fasthacks.cloud/openapi.json): the public ticket endpoints
- [ARD manifest](https://team-08.fasthacks.cloud/.well-known/ard.json): machine-readable discovery of Nullbox resources
